blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Wednesday slammed the Supreme Court (SC) after it dismissed petitions challenging her father former President Rodrigo Duterte’s arrest and turn over to the International Criminal Court (ICC). READ: ‘Beyond Court’s powers’: SC junks Rodrigo Duterte habeas corpus bids In a decision released by the SC Office of the Spokesperson on Tuesday, Nov. 24, the High Court voted 9-4 to deny the consolidated petitions filed by the former president’s children—Sebastian, Veronica, and Paolo Duterte—stating that his arrest was already “beyond the Court’s coercive powers,” and that he “stands accused before an international tribunal that […]...
